title: Letter A Song for Kids | A is for Apple | Learn the Alphabet with Lolo
description:
Sing, dance and learn the letter A with Lolo the Axolotl! 🍎
Kids learn big A and little a, the "a" sound, and A words: apple, ant, alligator and astronaut, then sing the A is for Apple song and play "Find the A".

Perfect for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2 to 6).

🔔 Subscribe for a new learning video every day: https://www.youtube.com/@LoloLearningLagoon?sub_confirmation=1

#LetterA #ABC #Phonics #KidsSongs #LolosLearningLagoon
